info.description: WeddingGiftBox's topic tags. Derived from what the brand actually is — a physical box of premium voucher booklets sent to newly-fixed couples — and from the partner verticals named on the About Us page: jewellery, traditional and western wedding apparel, travel and hotels, electronics and appliances, and sweets. Tags are topics and repeat per post; `category` is the single section a post belongs to and is a separate field. This is an enumeration, so adding a value is free but renaming or removing one orphans every entry already using it — treat a change as a data migration once content exists.
